evals.name: build-payment-gateway
evals.prompt: Build a WooCommerce payment gateway for MyPay that supports refunds and the block checkout.
evals.expected_output: PHP class extending WC_Payment_Gateway with id, init_form_fields(), process_payment() returning result array, process_refund() returning bool|WP_Error, webhook_handler() with HMAC signature verification. Register via woocommerce_payment_gateways filter. JS block integration: registerPaymentMethod() with canMakePayment, onPaymentSetup handler, paymentMethodData meta. PHP AbstractPaymentMethodType class passes settings to JS via get_payment_method_data().

evals.name: hpos-compatibility
evals.prompt: Add HPOS compatibility to my WooCommerce extension — it's breaking on WC 8.2+.
evals.expected_output: Declare HPOS compatibility via FeaturesUtil::declare_compatibility('custom_order_tables', __FILE__, true). Replace all get_post_meta($order_id) with $order->get_meta(). Replace WP_Query with wc_get_orders(). Replace update_post_meta with $order->update_meta_data()->save(). Remove direct $wpdb queries on posts/postmeta for orders. Admin column hooks: manage_woocommerce_page_wc-orders not edit-shop_order.

evals.name: custom-shipping-method
evals.prompt: Create a WooCommerce shipping method that calculates rates from an external API based on cart weight.
evals.expected_output: Class extends WC_Shipping_Method with id, supports=['shipping-zones','instance-settings'], init_form_fields() with title/api_key fields, calculate_shipping() that totals package weight, calls external API via wp_remote_post(), adds rate via $this->add_rate() with correct id, label, cost. Register via woocommerce_shipping_methods filter. is_available() check. Cache API response in transient keyed by weight+destination.
